values.note: Summer only: flush toilets and coin showers. Winter (Nov 1 - May 14): vault toilets and dump station only. Late 2026 drought notice: spigots, showers and flush toilets shut off, limited potable water at the visitor center; fill tanks before arriving.

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/sylvan-lake-state-park/sylvan-lake-state-park-camping-lodging ('Amenities include: ADA-accessible campsites, Vault toilets, Camper Services Building, Flush toilets (summer only), Coin-operated showers (summer only), Dump station, Water, Water spigots'; 'Winter amenities: Vault toilets, Dump station'; banner 'Water Shortage - Due to drought ... values.note: Reservation required: cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613, up to six months ahead; display a vehicle pass. Winter camping (Nov 1 - May 14) is first come, first served, paid at the self-serve station at the park entrance. 14 days in any 28; up to 6 people, 2 vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

note: Colorado Parks and Wildlife, Sylvan Lake State Park, on the north shore of the 42-acre lake east of the dam, ~8,500 ft, 16 mi south of Eagle by Brush Creek Road. No cell service. --Claude

Status: CPW's camping page carries a drought notice: 'Due to drought, the park is experiencing a water shortage. The campground water system is spring fed & running very low. Water spigots, showers & flush toilets have been shut off ... we do have limited potable water available at the Visitor Center'. Campground open; recorded in facilities.note, not as a closure.
Road: CPW gives directions only ('Turn south on Brush Creek Road and travel nine miles ...'); no road-condition, RV or 4WD wording and no closure on the park pages.

Elk Run and Fisherman's Paradise are two loops of one park off the same park road by the visitor center: the nearest sites (Elk Run 001, Fisherman's Paradise 044) are ~70 m apart and the loop centroids ~230 m apart, with no separate entrance. Under the split rule (~1 km+, own entrance) they would be one entry; left as two for AWH to decide.
Elevation: stored values (2328 / 2320 m) were taken at the wrong pin; the loops are at ~8,500 ft (~2,590 m) per CPW. Re-fetch with the corrected pin.

Waterfront (stored lakefront, confirmed): cpwshop tags 035 and 040 'Proximity to Water: Lakefront' (the other eight carry no tag). On imagery sites 035-039 line the north shore ~10-25 m from the water across open grass with no screen; 040-044 sit behind them, ~40-70 m back. The old evidence ('set back ~200m+') was read at the wrong pin. Sylvan Lake is a small dammed lake; the loop is above the dam, on the lake side.

Season: stored year_round true (derived from the old note's 'winter-camping loop').
